procedure: Read eight full example documents, every remaining unique raw-text prose variant (11/language including gender/clinical variants), and all 600 document slot rows. Code transcribed independently chosen entity spans from raw-text layouts. All text is represented by prose+slots; this is shared-context template-assisted session review, not 600 isolated inference contexts. Ratings assigned after reviewing prose and all slot values; no gold or external judgments used.
limitations: One session, repeated templates, template-assisted transcription and correlated ratings; not native-speaker/human validation. Source build metadata and author protocol, but no author review judgments, were read. Registry/address/bank reality not verified.
